Definition: adverb from G4009; the by-gone, i.e. (as noun) last year:--+ a year ago.
BiblicalUsage: Perysi means a year ago, last year, and Paul uses it twice when he writes to Corinth about giving. He reminds them that a year ago they were the first to be willing, and he tells the Macedonians that Achaia was ready a year ago, so their zeal stirred up many others.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Paul's reminder of a year ago is a gentle prod: a good intention a year old is still waiting to be finished, and the Corinthians' readiness had already stirred others to give.
